purpose: Illustrated Ink replay segmentation and prompt controls for a Sa'ueia child's first-route care handover with a bonded burden flower.

visual_scene_plan.purpose: Click-through visual anchors for ordinary packing, care instruction, an exposed burden-flower alarm, the route threshold, and four state-gated family outcomes.
visual_scene_plan.segmentation_rule: Use separate visual_scene_id anchors for the empty locality, character and object introduction, ordinary choice hub, routine fold, pivotal alarm, response hub, final threshold, and each ending family. The alarm appears on its own replay screen.
visual_scene_plan.prompting_rule: Each base image prompt describes a complete visible frame for a general image model. Fictional bodies, infrastructure, tools, light, and positions are stated concretely. Continuity notes remain tooling-only.
visual_scene_plan.global_style_cue: Painterly speculative-ecology storybook frame, restrained gouache and ink texture, low-energy bioluminescence, readable alien anatomy, precise living infrastructure, deep eclipse blues with muted amber and mineral earth, warm domestic observation under quiet moral pressure, cinematic interactive-fiction composition.
visual_scene_plan.prompt_assembly_rule: Assemble each generation prompt from global_style_cue, the scene base_image_prompt, visual refs only for named characters visible in that frame, and triggered state_image_modifiers or global_branch_image_modifiers. Keep continuity notes outside the assembled prompt. Use the scene_set camera slot as geometry authority.

scene_set_guidance.scope_reason: The visual plan contains a durable single-locality camera map with fixed zones, routes, occluders, staging slots, and prop anchors. It is sufficient for draft multi-angle replay without treating generated art as a floor plan.
scene_set_guidance.future_scene_set_need: A simple 3D blockout may replace the structured camera map for high-consistency production art while preserving these zone and camera ids.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Wide elevated establishing view of an alien communal nursery packing hollow carved into dark root-bound stone. The room is a shallow crescent around a low oval cradle of pale flexible ribs. Small nest alcoves line the inner left curve; leaf-skin storage pockets line the outer wall; a shallow clear mineral basin sits on the right. Thick living roots cross the low ceiling and carry hanging knots of cold blue bioluminescence. A broad shallow ramp rises from the center toward an outdoor terrace, where two rows of faint amber fungal fruiting beads mark a living road. Flexible route cords, folded shelter tissue, repair rolls, archive membranes, and three mineral spoons rest around the cradle. Low work surfaces and open floor lanes fit long horizontal six-limbed bodies.
visual_continuity_notes: Facing up the routeward ramp, nest alcoves remain left, the mineral basin remains right, the oval work cradle remains central, and archive pockets remain on the outer wall.
The fungal candles begin only at the ramp lip; the lantern knots hang from ceiling roots inside the hollow.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Medium-wide character staging around a low oval work cradle in a root-ceilinged nursery packing hollow. Senn, an adult long horizontal hexapod with rust-brown short fibers, four digitigrade running legs folded beneath the body, two small three-digit chest manipulators, a wedge-shaped head, and paired facial sensing fans, works at a balanced flank frame. Oru, a smaller tawny-gold juvenile of the same six-limbed body plan with oversized facial fans, sorts flexible route cords beside the cradle. A hand-sized mobile plant with pale green leaves, copper-edged sensory filaments, and clasping rootlets grips Oru's bare left flank. Talar, an older slate-gray hexapod with one nicked facial fan and woven care cords, spreads flexible violet-edged archive membranes on the cradle. Daro, a dark ochre adult hexapod with a repair harness, presses a bulky folded shelter roll against the family frame. Cold blue root lights illuminate three mineral spoons and the gently comic packing dispute.
